subject: general
question: 'Al Kiran' in India is a pioneering initiative co-led by the _________

options.text: Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser
National Association of Software and Service Companies

solution:
The correct answer is __**Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **'Al Kiran'** is a pioneering initiative in India co-led by the **Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA)** to the Government of India.

• The **Principal Scientific Adviser** plays a key role in advising on science and technology policies and their application for national development.

• The initiative focuses on fostering innovation, enabling the application of scientific research, and promoting sustainable development in India.

• It aims to address critical challenges in areas such as healthcare, agriculture, energy, and education through the use of science and technology.

• The **Office of the PSA** collaborates with various stakeholders, including research institutions, industry leaders, and government agencies, to implement such initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA):**

• The Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser was established in **1999** by the Government of India.

• The PSA's role includes providing **science and technology advice** to the Prime Minister and the Cabinet for formulating policies and strategies.

• It works to promote synergy between academia, industry, and government for scientific and technological advancements.

• The office also oversees the implementation of national missions and initiatives like **National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (NM-ICPS)** and other innovation-driven programs.

• **Key Functions of the PSA Office:**

• Advising on **strategic science and technology policies**.

• Collaborating with international organizations to promote global partnerships in science and technology.

• Overseeing the implementation of major national projects, such as those aimed at solving **climate change, energy security, and public health challenges**.

• **Other Relevant Organizations:**

• **NITI Aayog:** Focuses on policy formulation and economic development but is not directly involved in the 'Al Kiran' initiative.

• **Confederation of Indian Industry (CII):** Primarily represents industrial bodies and works on economic growth initiatives.

• **National Association of Software and Service Companies (NASSCOM):** Represents the IT and software services industry in India.

• **Importance of 'Al Kiran':**

• The initiative reflects India's commitment to leveraging **science and technology** for sustainable development.

• It emphasizes the need for innovation-driven solutions to address critical societal challenges.

• 'Al Kiran' serves as a model for integrating scientific research with policy-making and implementation at the national level.
